Before your visit

A few things
worth knowing.

Still have a question?
Talk to the shop: (407) 775-5455 ↗

01Do you only work on European cars?+

European vehicles are the shop’s specialty, but most makes and models are welcome. Include your vehicle details in the form so the team can confirm whether they can help.

02What should I include in my request?+

Your vehicle’s year, make and model, the service you need, and a short description of the problem. Mileage, warning lights and when symptoms started are helpful too.

03Does submitting the form book an appointment?+

No. It is a request, not a confirmed booking. The shop needs to follow up to agree on availability and the service required. In this private preview, the form does not send a message.

04Can I get a price before bringing the car in?+

Send the details of the service or concern. Some jobs require an inspection before an accurate estimate can be given. Ask the team what diagnosis involves and whether there is a diagnostic charge.

05What if I don’t know which service to choose?+

Select Diagnostics or Other and describe what you notice. You do not need to identify a faulty part before contacting the shop.

06Where is the shop?+

Revolution Imports is at 705 Industry Road, Longwood, FL 32750. Call ahead to confirm current hours and arrangements for dropping off your vehicle.
